meta.premiseEvidence: Current App, HUD, DeathScreen, Run History, storage, run-drill tests, Game Loop sources, and the S161 production baseline prove one truth-propagation gap across an otherwise persisted corrective-order loop.

gameLoopReview.evidenceBoundary: Structural scores only; no participant fun, balance, satisfaction, or retention claim.

axisCoverage.feature depth & refinement: Carry the existing corrective-order evidence through active play and history instead of creating another progression system.
axisCoverage.innovation: Turn a death recommendation into a local evidence chord spanning acceptance, live execution, observed result, and bounded repeatability.
axisCoverage.ui / ux / user-experience: Replace a reset-only mastery badge with the exact saved evidence state on desktop/mobile and add a concise archive surface.
axisCoverage.feedback loop: Make prior attempts visible before, during, and after the next correction run.
axisCoverage.gamification / engagement / immersion: Let humiliation become evidence-backed revenge without manufacturing streaks or grind.
axisCoverage.ai / intelligence integration: Preserve deterministic local coaching and evidence ranking; add no hosted inference or causal claim.
axisCoverage.security: Read only the existing bounded normalized Studio-event payloads; add no identity, network, secret, or untrusted-rendering boundary.
axisCoverage.speed / organization / efficiency: Centralize drill aggregation in one pure utility shared by HUD initialization, DeathScreen, and Run History.
axisCoverage.token / api cost reduction: Reuse existing local receipts and components with zero dependency and zero per-player API cost.

items.why: Every rematch initializes `practiceMastery` to one attempt and zero wins even when drill-specific outcomes already exist, so the live HUD contradicts saved evidence.
items.recipe: Add a pure drill-evidence aggregator, derive a prior-evidence snapshot from normalized `run_drill_outcome` events at run start, replace the mastery claim with an evidence receipt, and propagate it through responsive desktop/mobile HUD models.
items.measurement: Duplicate/malformed events fail closed; grouping is drill-specific and bounded; prior improvements render identically on desktop/mobile; no mastery or causal claim is introduced.

L1.recipe: Remove the reset-only label and render no evidence claim.

L2.recipe: Derive, test, and render persisted drill-specific evidence across both HUD paths.

L3.recipe: Add the L2 contract plus live transition announcements and richer visual states after evidence thresholds change.

items.why: Run History already receives the normalized Studio-event ledger, but ordinary players cannot revisit their corrective-order outcomes or repeatability evidence after leaving the death screen.
items.recipe: Use the shared aggregator to render a bounded Order Evidence section in Run History with drill title, attempts, observed improvements, latest wave delta, and explicit local/non-causal copy; cover empty, malformed, duplicate, and multi-drill cases.
items.measurement: At most four grouped orders render newest-first; raw payload/free text is never injected; the empty state stays quiet; desktop/mobile static rendering and focused pixels pass.

L1.recipe: Render only the latest normalized drill outcome.

L2.recipe: Render a bounded grouped archive with repeatability evidence and tests.

L3.recipe: Add L2 plus one-click same-seed relaunch when a valid bounded seed remains available.

items.why: The current Game Loop sources mention corrective drills and rematches but omit the persisted multi-attempt ledger and its observed-outcome-only ceiling.
items.recipe: Synchronize protocol and public Game Loop sources with the accepted-order, live-progress, outcome, evidence-ledger, and archive paths while preserving the local/advisory and non-causal boundary.
items.measurement: Both sources name the same evidence lifecycle, persistence boundary, and unavailable claims; public wording remains acronym-safe and proprietary-safe.

L1.recipe: Add the missing evidence-ledger sentence to both sources.

L2.recipe: Reconcile the full drill lifecycle and evidence boundaries in both sources.

L3.recipe: Add L2 plus a compact source-to-runtime evidence map for future audits.

Run History now exposes a newest-first, four-order local archive using normalized receipts and explicit non-causal wording.
Protocol and public Game Loop sources now describe the same accepted-order, live-progress, outcome, archive, and evidence-ceiling contract.
